title: Zesty Silky Greek Yogurt Moussaka
description: A fresh and silky Greek dish featuring full fat yogurt, this moussaka is a nostalgic treat that is both shojin-friendly and delicious. It is made with layers of eggplant, yogurt, and spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Brush the eggplant slices with olive oil and season with salt and black pepper.
Bake the eggplant slices in the oven for 20 minutes, flipping them halfway through.
In a bowl, mix together the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix together the chopped parsley and a pinch of salt.
To assemble the moussaka, create a layer of eggplant slices in the bottom of a baking dish.
Spread half of the yogurt mixture over the eggplant slices.
Repeat the layers, starting with the eggplant slices, then the remaining yogurt mixture, and finally the parsley mixture.
Bake the moussaka in the oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
